scope: Artifact integrity checks, not symnav correctness tests
checks: Every changed module is represented, including zero-callable test and entry modules.
Callable identifiers are unique and per-module counts reconcile.
Every present side has outputs, errors and effects; absent sides have no invented contract.
Every extracted member source is contained at the recorded source lines.
Every decision has a rationale status and valid source anchors.
All 39 policy leaves have distinct keys.
